# ADR-002: Reuse source-equivalent Rust math through generated adapters

Status: chosen

Concerns: Q-reproduce, Q-behavior

## Decision

Reuse existing Vec3::length/norm_squared after comparing their Rust syntax tree to the compiler-extracted C++ expression. Generate only the representation adapter and selected caller rewrites.

## Rationale

Existing arithmetic already matches the original grouping. Reuse prevents duplicated implementations and preserves existing tested work.

## Alternatives

Emit another copy of the arithmetic; retain the scaled norm.

## Consequences

Changing the reused methods invalidates the generator identity and requires renewed equivalence review and differential execution.
